title: add offline compatibility layer for signed Helm charts + rollback sanity checks
author: Maya Chen
description:
Motivation: air-gapped/private installs rely on pre-seeded OCI/Helm artifacts. With signed Helm charts becoming more common, our installer needed a compatibility layer to verify and consume signed charts in offline mode and a safer upgrade/rollback path that avoids unintentionally applying unsigned/downgrade artifacts. This PR implements a lightweight offline Helm signature verifier shim, extends the vendor index format with signature metadata, and adds pre-rollback sanity checks to the upgrade controller.

What this changes (high-level):
- Add 'offline-helm-signer' binary (Go) that verifies chart signatures using a provided keyring and emits a normalized unsigned chart tarball into the local cache if verification passes. Tool has explicit offline KMS/HSM integration hooks but defaults to local PEM keys for airgapped sites.
- Extend oci-index.json schema used by the installer to include 'signatures' and 'sig_key_id' fields so signed charts are discoverable during preflight.
- Installer preflight: verify all signed chart entries against the provided vendor keyring before seeding local OCI registry. Fail early with clear remediation steps if a signature cannot be validated.
- Terraform module (modules/registry) adds allow_signed_helm boolean flag and new input 'vendor_keyring_pem' to allow infra to provision the key material during initial bootstrap (stored as sealed secret when running with controller available).
- Upgrade controller: before performing an in-place upgrade we run a rollback-safety check that validates target manifests against last-known-good and ensures no implicit API downgrades or schema-unknown fields are introduced. If the check fails, the controller aborts and surfaces a deterministic diff blob to S3/local storage for operator review.
- Helm chart vendoring pipeline: CI job to index signed charts during vendor step and produce a compact signature index (used by offline-helm-signer).
- Docs and examples: private-installer/docs/offline-signed-charts.md and a Terraform example showing how to wire the keyring into an airgapped bootstrap.

Checklist (what I did):
- [x] Implement offline-helm-signer and unit tests for signature parsing/verification.
- [x] Add oci-index schema bump and migrate scripts (backwards compatible with unsigned-only indexes).
- [x] Integrate preflight verification into existing installer preflight flow with clear error codes.
- [x] Add rollback-safety checks and tests exercising downgrade/unknown-field detection.
- [x] Update Terraform module inputs and examples.
- [x] Add end-to-end smoke test that runs in CI airgap job using pre-seeded registry.
- [x] Add docs and runbook for operators to rotate vendor keys and recover from failed verification.

Review conversation (summarized):
- Priya Reddy: "We need to ensure the keyring rotation story does not block upgrades. Can we add a non-blocking validation mode for 'audit-only' during initial rollout?"
- Maya (author): "Added audit-only mode behind installer flag 'skip_signature_fail' and documented the operator workflow. Also added a rotate-keys.sh helper that creates new sealed secret artifacts for airgapped sites."
- Diego Alvarez: "Can offline-helm-signer verify both cosign and helm sigstore formats?"
- Maya: "It currently supports the Helm native signature format and a trimmed cosign-compatible verifier; added integration tests for both formats. We can extend if we see customer demand."
- Liam O'Connor: "Reviewed rollback-safety diffs — please add an opt-out label for workloads that manage CRD changes externally."
- Maya: "Added 'rollback_ignore_labels' controller config with allowlist semantics and added to docs."

CI notes:
- Airgap vendor job runs in a constrained runner and uses pre-seeded registry snapshot; flaked once on network timeout (job re-run fixed it).
- Unit and integration tests (Go) pass locally and in CI (linux/amd64).

Merging details:
- Merge method: squash
- Merge commit: a3f9b7d5c2e4b1f9a8c0d1e7f4b2a5c7d9e6f0a2
- Post-merge: created release note draft and flagged a follow-up to add ARM64 prebuilt binary step to the CI matrix (ENG-1320).

Operator runbook excerpt (short):
1) Provide vendor public keys as PEM in 'vendor_keyring_pem' when running bootstrap.
2) Run preflight; if signature check fails, fetch verification diff and key ID (error includes remediation link).
3) To rotate keys: run scripts/rotate-keys.sh to produce rotated sealed secret artifacts, upload to airgapped bundle, and re-run preflight in 'audit-only' then 'strict' modes.

Notes and rationale:
- We intentionally do not try to re-sign vendor artifacts in the installer; verification is preferred for provenance.
- The index schema bump is backward compatible: older installers will ignore 'signatures' entries but newer installers will validate if keyring provided.
